correctness.rationale: Clique-free domination removes every redundant vertex in each shore, leaving one endpoint per incident matching edge and one vertex per isolated shore; the clique replacement argument makes the strong collapses valid. A path of defect edges forces a contradiction in any full transversal from one terminal color to the other, hence the reduced complex is a full simplex. For a color cycle, only two consistent all-outgoing/all-incoming choices survive; across c cycles all forbidden transversals are 2^c unions of disjoint blocks. Two successive nerve-lemma applications show Alexander dual homotopy S^(c−1), so combinatorial Alexander duality puts exactly one integral reduced homology class in dimension 2k−c−2. The core is simply connected (complete 2-skeleton if k>=4; explicit S^3 for k=3); Hurewicz plus homological Whitehead yields sphere. Each isolated shore suspends, giving r+k−c−2; zero-matching case gives boundary simplex S^(r−2).
